events.filler.the_hours_between.title: The Hours Between
events.filler.the_hours_between.body: Nothing in either direction but the road doing what the road does. The light changes by degrees. You pass a sign for somewhere you are not going, then the same sign again forty minutes later, or one very like it.
events.filler.the_hours_between.out.noti: You notice the turning before the sign for it, and something about getting that right sets you up for the rest of the day.
events.filler.the_hours_between.out.noth: You watch carefully for two hours and are rewarded with two hours of exactly what you were looking at.
events.filler.the_hours_between.out.turn: You turn the useless thing over in your pocket for a while. It is not lucky and you are not superstitious, and you keep it anyway.
events.filler.the_hours_between.out.what: You eat what is left standing up, in about four minutes, without tasting any of it.
events.filler.the_long_quiet_stretch.bod: A straight road through nothing much, in weather that has no opinion. This is most of it, in the end: not the crossings or the arguments, just distance being turned into time at a steady and unremarkable rate.
events.filler.the_long_quiet_stretch.out: Kilometres. That is the entire content of the afternoon, and there is nothing wrong with it.
For an hour or so it is genuinely good — the road empty, the light long, and no reason to be anywhere else yet.
You stop somewhere that is not anywhere and sit for an hour. It costs you the hour and it is worth it.
There is a note in it that was not there yesterday. You find the loose thing making it and tighten it at the roadside in ten minutes.
You drive with the radio off and the window down for an hour and learn nothing except that you are tired of the sound of it.
